|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">密輸屋。顔に醜いブラスター痕のある心の歪んだ“医師”。12以上の星系で死刑判決。ポンダ・バーバの悪名高きパートナー。別名、ドクター・コーネリアス・ルーフー。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Dr. Evazan.

'''Card text:''' Immediately “operates” on a character at the same site that was just hit by a weapon or that has Disarmed. The patient is immediately lost. A starship he pilots is power +2.

'''Lore:''' Smuggler. A twisted “doctor” with an ugly blaster scar. Death sentence in 12 or more systems. Notorious partner of Ponda Baba. Alias Dr. Cornelius Rooboo.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names 切断された腕 for Disarmed.
|notes='''Dr. Evazan (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Dr. Evazan|Dr. Evazan]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Dr. Evazan (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R9 at rarity VR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R9.
